definitions.explanation: A track and field event in which athletes throw a spear-shaped implement (javelin) as far as possible.

examples.japanese: やり{投|な}げの{選手|せんしゅ}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become a javelin thrower.

examples.japanese: やり{投|な}げで{金|きん}メダルを{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: Won a gold medal in the javelin throw.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はやり{投|な}げの{日本記録|にほんきろく}を{更新|こうしん}した。
examples.english: He set a new Japanese record in the javelin throw.

notes:
One of the throwing events in track and field ({陸上競技|りくじょうきょうぎ}). The javelin ({槍|やり}) is thrown from behind a foul line after a running approach.

RELATED THROWING EVENTS:
- {砲丸投|ほうがんな}げ: shot put
- {円盤投|えんばんな}げ: discus throw
- ハンマー{投|な}げ: hammer throw

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やり{投|な}げの{選手|せんしゅ}: javelin thrower
- やり{投|な}げの{記録|きろく}: javelin throw record
- やり{投|な}げ{競技|きょうぎ}: javelin throw competition

FORMS:
やり ({槍|やり}, spear/javelin) + {投|な}げ (throw, from {投|な}げる)
